claude-pro.one_liner: an AI assistant for writing, coding, research and analysis
benefits: much higher usage than the free plan
access to the most capable Claude models
Projects to organise your documents and chats
claude-pro.call_to_action: send you a payment link on SMS
claude-pro.pitch_hi: Claude Pro एक AI असिस्टेंट है जो लिखने, कोडिंग और रिसर्च में मदद करता है, और इसमें फ्री प्लान से कहीं ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल मिलता है।
claude-pro.pitch_hinglish: Claude Pro ek AI assistant hai jo likhne, coding aur research mein madad karta hai, aur isme free plan se kahin zyada usage milta hai.
claude-pro.pitch_en: Claude Pro is an AI assistant for writing, coding and research, with far more usage than the free plan.
claude-pro.knowledge: Claude is an AI assistant made by Anthropic. People use it by typing or talking to it to write and edit text, write and debug code, analyse documents and data, research topics and brainstorm. It works on the web (claude.ai), on iPhone and Android apps and on desktop. Claude Pro is the paid individual plan: much more usage than the free plan, access to more models, and Projects to keep documents and chats together. It is software, not a physical product; nothing is shipped. Limits: it cannot create images or videos (it can read and understand images, PDFs and files you upload); it needs the internet, there is no offline mode; it cannot make bookings, payments or phone calls for you. A Pro subscription is for one person's account and should not be shared; groups use the separate Team plan. Students, writers, developers and small businesses use it; it can explain homework step by step. This offer is for new Pro subscriptions: someone who already pays for Pro keeps their current plan and price, and someone on the free plan can take the offer. Many people use Claude alongside other assistants such as ChatGPT; people often pick Claude for careful writing, working with long documents and coding help. Coding: it explains problems step by step, helps debug, and can read long code files; good for practising DSA. It writes and edits reports and assignments and works in Hindi and many other languages. Privacy: Anthropic may use chats to improve its models only if the user allows it; each user chooses this in their privacy settings, and the full policy is at anthropic.com/privacy (say exactly this; do not claim it never uses data). Billing: there is also yearly billing that works out cheaper per month (exact price on the pricing page). There is no separate student discount in this offer; the discount already applies. Cancelling stops the next renewal and access continues until the end of the paid month; refunds follow the policy on the website. Anthropic is a real AI safety and research company, founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco, that makes Claude; the official site is anthropic.com. The payment page shows the payment methods; card works, and other methods depend on what the page shows (do not promise UPI or any specific method). The payment link comes by SMS to the number we called. Renewal: the subscription renews automatically every month; after the first 3 months it renews at $20 a month until the user cancels (say this plainly if asked whether money is taken automatically). Models: Pro includes Anthropic's latest Claude models, including the most capable Opus and the fast Sonnet; usage is roughly five times the free plan, counted in sessions that reset every five hours; the exact number of messages depends on their length, so there is no fixed message count (say so plainly). The $8 offer is only for the monthly plan. Yearly billing is listed at about $200 a year (about $17 a month) with no extra offer; Team plan prices are on the website. The SMS with the link usually arrives within a couple of minutes and opens Anthropic's official claude.ai page. Receipts and invoices for each payment are available in the account's billing settings. For a shop or small business it helps: GST calculations, bill formats, lists of dues (udhaari), and drafting WhatsApp or SMS messages to customers (it writes them, the user sends them); the user should check the numbers. Tally (टैली/टेली) is accounting software; Claude is not a replacement for Tally, but helps alongside it. OTP: on the payment page the user's own bank may send an OTP to approve the payment; it must never be shared with anyone, including this call. If an existing subscriber asks whether cancelling and signing up again with a new account would get the offer: you don't know that and must not promise it. Colleagues or friends who don't have Pro yet can each take this offer on their own account. The SMS comes from Anthropic, not from a bank, and the link opens Anthropic's own claude.ai payment page. Never suggest making another account or email to get the offer, and never claim what is or isn't allowed for second accounts; you can't confirm those rules. If asked where we got their number: you don't have details of the list's source; offer to remove the number.

fitzone-gym.one_liner: a gym membership with trainers and group classes
benefits: a free personal trainer session every week
unlimited group classes like yoga and zumba
fitzone-gym.call_to_action: send you the joining link on SMS
fitzone-gym.pitch_hi: FitZone एक जिम है जहाँ ट्रेनर, योगा और ज़ुम्बा क्लासेस मिलती हैं, और ये सुबह पाँच से रात ग्यारह बजे तक खुला रहता है।
fitzone-gym.pitch_hinglish: FitZone ek gym hai jahan trainer, yoga aur zumba classes milti hain, aur ye subah paanch baje se raat gyaarah baje tak khula rehta hai.
fitzone-gym.pitch_en: FitZone is a gym with trainers and yoga and zumba classes, open from 5 in the morning to 11 at night.
fitzone-gym.knowledge: FitZone is a neighbourhood gym chain (operator demo facts, not a real company). Membership includes gym floor access, cardio and weights, group classes (yoga, zumba, HIIT), one free personal trainer session per week, lockers and showers. All branches are air-conditioned; there is no steam room or sauna. Equipment: cardio machines (treadmills, cycles, cross-trainers), free weights (dumbbells, barbells, plates), benches for bench press, a squat rack, cable machines and leg press. Branches (Delhi NCR): Saket (Delhi), Sector 29 (Gurugram) and Sector 62 (Noida); there is no branch in Sector 49 Gurugram, the nearest is Sector 29. Open every day 5 am to 11 pm. Women-only batch at every branch, every day 10 am to 12 noon and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a woman trainer. Free parking for cars and bikes at all branches. Plans: monthly 2,200 rupees, quarterly (3 months) 6,000 rupees, annual 21,000 rupees (about 1,750 rupees a month). The launch offer is 2,999 rupees for the first 3 months if you join this week, then the quarterly rate. Payment: UPI, debit or credit card, net banking, or cash at the front desk; nothing is charged on the call. Membership starts the same day: after payment, walk in with the SMS and a photo ID. Documents: one government photo ID (Aadhaar, driving licence or passport). Age: 16 and above (under 18 needs a parent's consent), no upper age limit; with a health condition, ask your doctor first. A one-day free trial pass is available by walking in to any branch with an ID (it cannot be sent by SMS). Refund: within 3 days of joining, if the gym has not been used, the fee is refunded minus a 500 rupee admin charge; after that no refund, but you can freeze. Cancellation: you can cancel any time at the front desk; fees already paid follow the refund rule. Freeze: up to 15 days. There is no joining fee in this offer. Extra personal training sessions beyond the free weekly one are 600 rupees each. No student, group or friend discount in this offer; referral: when a friend joins you both get one extra free personal trainer session. Joining: open the link sent by SMS or walk into the nearest branch; the trainer does a free fitness assessment on day one.

faqs.answer: One personal trainer session a week is free; extra sessions are 600 rupees each
faqs.answer_hi: हफ़्ते में एक पर्सनल ट्रेनर सेशन फ्री है; उसके अलावा हर एक्स्ट्रा सेशन के 600 रुपये लगते हैं
faqs.answer_hinglish: Hafte mein ek personal trainer session free hai; uske alawa har extra session ke 600 rupaye lagte hain

faqs.answer: If you change your mind within 3 days of joining and have not used the gym, the fee is refunded minus a 500 rupee admin charge; after that there is no refund, but you can freeze the membership
faqs.answer_hi: जॉइन करने के 3 दिन के अंदर अगर आपने जिम इस्तेमाल नहीं किया, तो फीस वापस मिलती है, बस 500 रुपये एडमिन चार्ज कटता है; उसके बाद रिफंड नहीं है, पर आप मेंबरशिप फ्रीज़ कर सकते हैं
faqs.answer_hinglish: Join karne ke 3 din ke andar agar aapne gym use nahi kiya, to fees wapas milti hai, bas 500 rupaye admin charge katta hai; uske baad refund nahi hai, par aap membership freeze kar sakte hain

faqs.answer: You can pay by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking, or cash at the front desk
faqs.answer_hi: आप UPI, डेबिट या क्रेडिट कार्ड, नेट बैंकिंग, या फ्रंट डेस्क पर कैश से पेमेंट कर सकते हैं
faqs.answer_hinglish: Aap UPI, debit ya credit card, net banking, ya front desk par cash se payment kar sakte hain

faqs.answer: Plans are monthly at 2,200 rupees, quarterly for 3 months at 6,000 rupees, and annual at 21,000 rupees, about 1,750 rupees a month; this week's launch offer is 2,999 rupees for the first 3 months
faqs.answer_hi: प्लान ये हैं: मंथली 2,200 रुपये, तीन महीने का 6,000 रुपये, और सालाना 21,000 रुपये यानी करीब 1,750 रुपये महीना; इस हफ़्ते का लॉन्च ऑफर पहले 3 महीने के 2,999 रुपये है
faqs.answer_hinglish: Plans ye hain: monthly 2,200 rupaye, teen mahine ka 6,000 rupaye, aur annual 21,000 rupaye yaani kareeb 1,750 rupaye mahina; is hafte ka launch offer pehle 3 mahine ke 2,999 rupaye hai

faqs.answer: Your membership starts the same day: after payment, walk in with the SMS and a photo ID
faqs.answer_hi: आपकी मेंबरशिप उसी दिन शुरू हो जाती है: पेमेंट के बाद SMS और फ़ोटो ID लेकर सीधे आ जाइए
faqs.answer_hinglish: Aapki membership usi din shuru ho jaati hai: payment ke baad SMS aur photo ID lekar seedhe aa jaiye

faqs.answer: We have three branches in Delhi NCR: Saket in Delhi, Sector 29 in Gurugram and Sector 62 in Noida; there is no branch in Sector 49 Gurugram, the nearest is Sector 29

faqs.answer_hinglish: Delhi NCR mein hamari teen branch hain: Delhi mein Saket, Gurugram mein Sector 29 aur Noida mein Sector 62; Gurugram ke Sector 49 mein branch nahi hai, sabse paas Sector 29 hai

faqs.answer: The gym is open every day from 5 am to 11 pm

faqs.answer_hinglish: Gym roz subah 5 baje se raat 11 baje tak khula rehta hai

faqs.answer: You can get a one-day free trial pass by walking in to any branch with an ID; it can't be sent by SMS

faqs.answer_hinglish: Teeno branch mein car aur bike ki parking free hai

faqs.answer_hinglish: Sabhi branch AC hain, aur locker aur shower shamil hain; steam room ya sauna nahi hai

faqs.answer_hinglish: Bas ek sarkari photo ID chahiye, jaise Aadhaar, driving licence ya passport; payment SMS link se ya front desk par kar sakte hain

faqs.answer: Members must be 16 or older, and under 18 needs a parent's consent; there is no upper age limit
faqs.answer_hi: मेंबर की उम्र 16 साल या उससे ज़्यादा होनी चाहिए, 18 से कम हो तो माता-पिता की इजाज़त चाहिए; ऊपर की कोई उम्र सीमा नहीं है
faqs.answer_hinglish: Member ki umar 16 saal ya usse zyada honi chahiye, 18 se kam ho to parents ki ijazat chahiye; upar ki koi umar seema nahi hai

faqs.answer: You can cancel any time at the front desk; fees already paid follow the refund rule
faqs.answer_hi: आप कभी भी फ्रंट डेस्क पर मेंबरशिप कैंसल कर सकते हैं; दी हुई फीस रिफंड के नियम के हिसाब से होगी
faqs.answer_hinglish: Aap kabhi bhi front desk par membership cancel kar sakte hain; di hui fees refund ke niyam ke hisaab se hogi

faqs.answer: You can freeze the membership for up to 15 days
faqs.answer_hi: आप मेंबरशिप पंद्रह दिन तक रोक सकते हैं
faqs.answer_hinglish: Aap membership pandrah din tak rok sakte hain

faqs.answer: There is no joining fee in this offer
faqs.answer_hi: इस ऑफर में कोई जॉइनिंग फीस नहीं है
faqs.answer_hinglish: Is offer mein koi joining fee nahi hai

faqs.answer: There is no student, friend or group discount in this offer, and the launch price is already 50% off; when a friend joins through you, you both get one extra free personal trainer session
faqs.answer_hi: इस ऑफर में स्टूडेंट, दोस्त या ग्रुप डिस्काउंट नहीं है, और लॉन्च कीमत पहले से 50% off है; अगर आपके ज़रिए कोई दोस्त जुड़ता है तो आप दोनों को एक एक्स्ट्रा फ्री पर्सनल ट्रेनर सेशन मिलता है
faqs.answer_hinglish: Is offer mein student, friend ya group discount nahi hai, aur launch price pehle se 50% off hai; agar aapke zariye koi dost judta hai to aap dono ko ek extra free personal trainer session milta hai

faqs.answer: Fair question. It is our launch offer for this week, you pay only at the gym or through the official link, nothing is charged on this call
faqs.answer_hi: अच्छा सवाल है। ये इस हफ्ते का लॉन्च ऑफर है, पेमेंट सिर्फ़ जिम पर या ऑफिशियल लिंक से होता है, इस कॉल पर कुछ नहीं कटता
faqs.answer_hinglish: Achha sawal hai. Ye is hafte ka launch offer hai, payment sirf gym par ya official link se hota hai, is call par kuch nahi katta

fitzone-gym.tone: warm, respectful and conversational, like a helpful person, never pushy

renewal_note.en: The offer price is for the first 3 months; after that it's 6,000 rupees for 3 months, and you can cancel any time at the front desk.
renewal_note.hi: Offer वाली कीमत पहले 3 महीने की है; उसके बाद 3 महीने के ₹6,000 लगेंगे, और आप कभी भी फ्रंट डेस्क पर कैंसल कर सकते हैं।
renewal_note.hinglish: Offer wali keemat pehle 3 mahine ki hai; uske baad 3 mahine ke ₹6,000 lagenge, aur aap kabhi bhi front desk par cancel kar sakte hain.

fitzone-gym.sms_text: {seller}: your {product} offer at {offer_price}. Pay securely at {link} . Never share OTP or card details on a call.

terms.en: ₹2,999 for 3 months if you join this week, then ₹6,000 for 3 months
terms.hi: इस हफ़्ते join करने पर 3 महीने के ₹2,999, उसके बाद 3 महीने के ₹6,000
terms.hinglish: is hafte join karne par 3 mahine ke ₹2,999, uske baad 3 mahine ke ₹6,000

discovery_question.en: What's your fitness goal: losing weight, building muscle, or just staying fit?
discovery_question.hi: आपका fitness goal क्या है: weight कम करना, muscle बनाना, या बस fit रहना?
discovery_question.hinglish: Aapka fitness goal kya hai: weight kam karna, muscle banana, ya bas fit rehna?

benefits_hi: हर हफ़्ते एक फ्री पर्सनल ट्रेनर सेशन
योगा और ज़ुम्बा जैसी अनलिमिटेड ग्रुप क्लासेस
सुबह 5 बजे से रात 11 बजे तक खुला रहता है
benefits_hinglish: har hafte ek free personal trainer session
yoga aur zumba jaisi unlimited group classes
subah 5 baje se raat 11 baje tak khula rehta hai

info_source.en: the gym team at the nearest branch can tell you
info_source.hi: नज़दीकी ब्रांच पर जिम की टीम आपको बता सकती है
info_source.hinglish: nazdeeki branch par gym ki team aapko bata sakti hai

fitzone-gym.description: operator demo facts: FitZone is the operator's own demo gym, not a real company. Every fact in this sheet (plans, branches, policies, rates) is authored demo data; the operator confirms or replaces it (see docs/PRODUCT_FACTS_TODO.md).

trial_pass.en: What I can offer is a one-day free trial pass: walk into any branch with an ID and try it before you decide.
trial_pass.hi: मैं एक दिन का फ्री ट्रायल पास दे सकता हूँ: किसी भी ब्रांच में ID लेकर आइए और तय करने से पहले आज़मा लीजिए।
trial_pass.hinglish: Main ek din ka free trial pass de sakta hoon: kisi bhi branch mein ID lekar aaiye aur tay karne se pehle try kar lijiye.

cheaper_plan.en: If 3 months at once is too much, there is also a monthly plan at 2,200 rupees a month.
cheaper_plan.hi: अगर एक साथ 3 महीने भारी लग रहे हैं, तो 2,200 रुपये महीने का मंथली प्लान भी है।
cheaper_plan.hinglish: Agar ek saath 3 mahine bhaari lag rahe hain, to 2,200 rupaye mahine ka monthly plan bhi hai.

annual_saving.en: The annual plan is 21,000 rupees, about 1,750 rupees a month, which is the lowest per-month rate we have.
annual_saving.hi: सालाना प्लान 21,000 रुपये का है, यानी करीब 1,750 रुपये महीना, जो हमारा सबसे कम मासिक रेट है।
annual_saving.hinglish: Annual plan 21,000 rupaye ka hai, yaani kareeb 1,750 rupaye mahina, jo hamara sabse kam monthly rate hai.

referral.en: If a friend joins through you, you both get one extra free personal trainer session.
referral.hi: अगर आपके ज़रिए कोई दोस्त जुड़ता है, तो आप दोनों को एक एक्स्ट्रा फ्री पर्सनल ट्रेनर सेशन मिलता है।
referral.hinglish: Agar aapke zariye koi dost judta hai, to aap dono ko ek extra free personal trainer session milta hai.
